producer: LLM research content reading; not independent human-reader evaluation

method.product_output_review_start: after independent Games 1-5 notes were fixed
method.quality_metric: Useful answer to the chosen bounded chess question, with claim-changing witnessed replies/costs retained. Text length alone is not quality.
method.actual_game_vs_product_pv: Actual future game moves are independent hypotheses; only the product-provided line can create a required reply/cost obligation for a product claim.
method.state_scope: Current and before/needs_refresh assessment states are read separately. A needs_refresh basic rendering may have a stale-comparison limitation; no scope mismatch is inferred solely from unusual SAN or zero mechanism_focuses.
method.san_scope: Every referenced move is checked against its own line_id and offset; later occurrences can legitimately use a different SAN from the root move.
method.required_reply_cost_preserved_values: true / false / null (no applicable claimed obligation or unavailable reading)
method.product_vs_automation: Source/structure observations support, but do not replace, move-specific content reading. Human-reader evaluation was not performed.
method.visible_basic: summary_unavailable comparisons have basic_text null and an incomplete notice in the actual front end. Legacy detail is not counted as visible basic prose. Export v3 is used; prior export fallback was a research representation error, not a product error.
method.balanced_stratification: Use only actual admitted unrestricted initial D16-or-deeper evaluation: complete requested MultiPV packet, and each reported legal continuation present in the public owned paths. Verification may still be pending while awaiting played focus; complete verification flag alone is not the admission condition. Partial shallow packets remain balance unknown. Root before reviewed move is the stratum; a later played mistake does not exclude a move.
method.failure_boundary_rule: Question/discovery means the useful bounded comparison or needed witness was not obtained. Answer selection means the visible answer chooses unrelated fragments or does not substantively answer the reviewed arm despite available evidence. Composition/delivery requires evidence that already-selected content is lost or misstated in realization/display; existence only in detail does not prove core selection. Runtime failures and research-executor limitations are separately qualified.
method.front_end_scope_read: Read-only source view/moveReview.ts:2373-2394 and2442-2457 confirms structured question units render whole in basic, structured detail units fold under What happens next, summary_unavailable yields notice; exact line/occurrence determines SAN interaction. No browser execution performed.
